MelaMur shows a map of Malta and helps you while riding the bus.

What we collect: only while your phone sees the on-board network "Tallinja Wi-Fi", MelaMur switches on GPS and sends your position, speed and heading, together with a random trip identifier, to melamur.snel.it. No name, account, phone number or advertising ID is collected. When you leave the bus, GPS is switched off and collection stops.

Why: the positions of all participating riders are combined with bus stop and timetable data to build a more accurate live bus map of Malta (legal basis: your consent, Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).

Retention: raw positions are kept at most 30 days, after which only anonymous aggregates remain.

Your rights: you can withdraw consent at any time via the Privacy button; the map keeps working without it. You have the right to access, rectification, erasure and to lodge a complaint with the Information and Data Protection Commissioner (IDPC, Malta). Controller contact: privacy@snel.it.
